body:
📚 **kb-update** — pir-ingest cycle 2026-05-25

Pulled Confluence PIR (pageId 133496969), parsed 19 engineer-authored incident blocks, deduped against the 7 existing KB entries, wrote **9 new entries** to `kb/known-issues.json` (confidence 0.95) and committed (`8288108`).

**New entries:**

| id | jira | title |
|---|---|---|
| `ki-billingengine-api-key1-removed-in-refactor` | PL-62423 | billingengine-api subscription pages 500 after Friday release removed API key1 used by nightly billing agent |
| `ki-calendar-sync-net-framework-version-mismatch` | — | Calendar Sync deploy fails health check when project targets a .NET Framework version not installed on server |
| `ki-gmail-sidebar-google-bandwidth-quota-exceeded` | PL-62491 | Method:Sidebar (Gmail) 'Bandwidth quota exceeded' from Google's auth discovery endpoints |
| `ki-ios-text-input-disabled-keyboard-onfocus` | PL-44055 | iOS 17+ users: keyboard fails to open on customized text-input controls (disabled-state OS behavior change) |
| `ki-legacy-syncservice-wrong-version-deployed` | — | Wrong version of legacy-syncservice-api breaks QBDT sync + Accounting View Deltas + account signup |
| `ki-ms-account-redis-cache-timeout-on-cold-start` | PL-44270 | ms-account-api slow during release because /health/heartbeat passes before Redis is reachable |
| `ki-rabbitmq-audittrail-overflow-from-large-qbo-sync` | PL-44203 | RabbitMQ goes critical when audit-trail queue fills from a large qbo-sync-api customer change burst |
| `ki-runtime-core-target-group-port-mismatch` | PL-54148 / PL-54150 | runtime-core-api node 404s after re-registration because target group default port was 5000 instead of 80 |
| `ki-stock-app-routines-global-vs-account-scoping` | PL-55177 | Pause/resume of one customer's stock app routine flips all accounts because JobSchedule filter omitted AccountId |

**Skipped (already represented):** DNS/microservices.method.int, MongoDB rs01 FD exhaustion, Classic UI EDA NuGet, QBO Sync Datadog/MassTransit, Redis SCAN cache-clear — all 5 prior PIR-derived entries already in the KB.

**Skipped (low confidence — Hard Rule 2):**
- Block 14 (2025-05-20, runtime screens 20-min outage) — root cause given as "Redis + Ansible," too vague to write a useful match rule.
- Block 16 (2024-01-19, Shuttle portal outage) — root cause was "Shuttle still investigating," vendor-side and unresolved at write time.
- Block 18 (2023-11-29, tables-fields after Windows patch) — root cause is explicit "current speculation," not confirmed.
- Block 21 (2023-11-15, Shuttle payments fail) — root cause given as "bad release from Shuttle, still awaiting further details."

KB now contains **16 entries** (7 existing + 9 new). Triage routine will pick up the new patterns on the next cycle.
